description: List the documents a company listed in Canada filed on SEDAR+, the Canadian securities regulators' filing system, for the issuer of one Canadian listing written MIC:TICKER (e.g. XTSE:SHOP, XCNQ:...), newest first: annual and interim financial statements, MD&A, annual information forms, information circulars, news releases, material change reports and prospectuses. Each row gives the filing date, the regulator's category, the document name and a link that opens the document (a PDF) on its Equibles page. Narrow with query, whose words must all appear in the document name or category (e.g. 'financial statements', 'MD&A', 'circular'), and with a date range. The documents' text is not searchable: ListFilings, SearchDocuments and ReadDocumentLines cover SEC filings and transcripts, which a Canadian company has only when it also files with the SEC. For reported figures use GetFinancialStatement.

query.description: Optional words (at most 6) that must all appear in the document name or category, in any case, e.g. 'annual financial statements', 'MD&A', 'information circular'.

ticker.description: Canadian listing symbol MIC:TICKER, e.g. XTSE:SHOP. A bare ticker names a US listing and is answered with the company's Canadian listings to ask with.

name: GetCanadianFilings
title: Canadian Regulatory Filings (SEDAR+)
